name: As You Are
one_liner: Digital mental health assessment and outcomes platform
short_description: As You Are provides digital mental health assessment and outcomes measurement tools for behavioral health practices. Enables standardized screening, progress tracking, and measurement-based care...
long_description:
As You Are is a digital platform focused on mental health assessment and outcomes measurement. The platform provides tools for administering standardized assessments, tracking patient progress over time, and implementing measurement-based care approaches.

The system enables clinicians to send assessments to patients electronically, collect responses, and view results in dashboards that highlight symptom trends and treatment progress. This supports data-driven clinical decision making and demonstrates treatment effectiveness.

As You Are serves behavioral health practices seeking to formalize their outcomes measurement processes. The platform can help practices meet quality reporting requirements and provide patients with tangible evidence of their progress in treatment.

As a measurement-focused platform, As You Are complements rather than replaces EHR systems. Practices would typically use it alongside their existing clinical documentation tools to add structured outcomes tracking capabilities.
best_for: Behavioral health practices demonstrating treatment effectiveness
not_for: Organizations with existing robust measurement tools
Practices not focused on outcomes documentation
